retrievalProfile.description: A gritty, high-contrast composition featuring backlit figures in a distressed architectural setting with weathered, stencil-like typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A group of men walking toward the viewer in a dilapidated, brightly backlit hallway, framed by a dark, textured upper border containing weathered display text.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast silhouettes against a blown-out light source
Distressed, peeling ceiling textures framing the top third
Warm sepia and ochre tones contrasting with dark brown shadows
Centered, hierarchical typography placed in the dark negative space
coreInvariants: Weathered stencil-effect on primary display text
Strong backlighting creating rim light on subjects
Horizontal division between dark textured header and bright photographic scene

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body figures arranged horizontally across the lower two-thirds, scaled to appear mid-ground.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central bright light source behind the figures.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large distressed title at the top, move down to the secondary text, and follow the light through the figures to the floor.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy dark brown negative space at the top serves as a container for the typography.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with extreme value contrast between the dark header and the blown-out center.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif or industrial sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Simulated paint-peeling or erosion texture applied to the fill
Uniform stroke width with slight rounding at corners from weathering
characterSpecificRedesigns: Eroded edges on all glyphs to mimic stencil wear
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Distressed heavy display paired with a clean, widely-spaced geometric sans-serif.
graphicDevices: Torn paper/peeling paint edge transition between header and photo

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the industrial, weathered stencil look
Similar wide, low-contrast structure for the subtitle

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photo of a group of men walking through a dilapidated, sun-drenched hallway with heavy backlighting. Add a dark brown textured border at the top with a jagged, peeling paint edge.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply the main title in a distressed, off-white stencil font. Place the subtitle below it in a clean, ochre-colored sans-serif with wide letter spacing.

verificationChecks: Is the top text visibly eroded or distressed?
Is the subtitle tracking significantly wider than the title?
Is the transition between the dark header and the photo jagged and textured?

adjustableVariables: Amount of erosion on the typography
Number of figures in the hallway
mustRedesign: Do not use specific band logos
Do not use exact facial features of the original subjects
postGenerationChecks: Check that the text is centered horizontally.
Ensure the figures are primarily in silhouette.
Verify the 'peeling' effect at the header boundary.
Confirm the color palette is restricted to browns, ochres, and whites.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a dark, textured header containing distressed stencil type with a high-contrast, backlit urban-decay photograph.
